regions.name: footer
regions.description: Specifies a footer for the dialog, typically action buttons. If empty, the footer isn't displayed.

regions.name: header
regions.description: Specifies the heading of the dialog.

regions.name: headerActions
regions.description: Actions displayed in the header row, before the close button.

properties.name: i18nStrings
properties.description:
An object containing all the necessary localized strings required by the component.

- `dismissAriaLabel` (string) - Adds an `aria-label` to the close button.

events.name: onDismiss
events.description:
Called when the user dismisses the dialog using the close button or the Escape key.
Use the event handler to remove the dialog from the page.
When the dialog unmounts, it returns focus to the element that was focused before it mounted, as long as that element still exists.
